items.name: base
items.title: Base
items.description: Sets Lucide as the icon library and installs the default theme, color-scheme and reduced-motion base styles. Run shadcn init with it in a new project; in an existing one, shadcn add installs the styles and keeps your icon library.

items.name: theme
items.title: Theme
items.description: Design tokens (color system) shared by all oakoss/ui components.

theme.font-heading: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', 'Noto Sans', Arial, sans-serif, 'Apple Color Emoji', 'Segoe UI Emoji', 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Noto Color Emoji'
theme.font-mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', 'Courier New', monospace
theme.font-sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', 'Noto Sans', Arial, sans-serif, 'Apple Color Emoji', 'Segoe UI Emoji', 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Noto Color Emoji'

items.name: themes
items.title: Themes
items.description: Every theme family and primary color as CSS scoped by data-family and data-primary, for apps that switch themes at runtime. Installs src/styles/themes.css and imports it from your stylesheet.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Accessible button built on React Aria Components.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Label, description, error and input parts that wire into any React Aria field, plus fieldset, group, orientation and separator layout.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Single-line text control built on React Aria Components, in control heights that match Button; use it inside a text field.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Multiline text control built on React Aria Components that grows with its content between minRows and maxRows; use it inside a text field.

items.name: text-field
items.title: Text Field
items.description: Text input or multiline textarea with a label, description and error, built on React Aria Components; pass children to compose the field parts.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Modal dialog built on React Aria Components, with a title, description and close button wired to the dialog.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: Dialog that interrupts with a decision: focus starts on Cancel, and the action shows a pending state until its work finishes.

items.name: contextual-help
items.title: Contextual Help
items.description: Help or info icon button that opens a popover of explanation, for content a tooltip can't hold or touch can't reach.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: Non-modal preview of a link's content on hover, keyboard focus or long press, built on React Aria's PreviewTrigger.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Floating panel anchored to a trigger, built on Dialog's parts, with an optional arrow and a scrolling body for tall content.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: Panel that slides in from an edge of the screen, built on Dialog; start and end sides follow the text direction.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Short label shown on keyboard focus, or on hover after half a second, with an arrow pointing at its trigger.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A person's image with initials that show until it loads or when it fails, plus a status badge and an overlapping group.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: Spinning indicator announced as an indeterminate progress bar named by a label prop, inline so it fits in text and buttons.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Progress bar with a label and formatted value, or parts to lay out your own, in primary, success, warning, destructive and info intents, and an indeterminate fill that slides across the track and rests in the middle under reduced motion.

items.name: meter
items.title: Meter
items.description: Meter for a value within a known range, such as storage used, with a label and formatted value, or parts to lay out your own, in primary, success, warning, destructive and info intents.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Placeholder shape with a pulse, hidden from screen readers, shown while content loads.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Surface for related content, with a header that takes an action, a title heading, a description, content and a footer.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: Horizontal or vertical divider line, drawn as a border so it stays visible in forced colors.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Checkbox with its label as the click target, a minus for indeterminate, and a description and error wired with no ids.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: Empty state with a heading, description, decorative media and actions.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Callout with a title, description and action, in neutral, info, success, warning and destructive intents with an icon each, static by default and live only when given a role.

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: A row of media, title, description and actions, in a list that passes axe, with a linked title stretched over the row so its actions stay pressable and a default look that stays borderless in Windows High Contrast.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Keyboard key and key combination, with a label for glyph keys and unique ids inside menu items.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Short label or count in neutral, primary, success, warning, destructive and info intents, each solid, soft or outline, with badgeStyles for a link or button that adds hover, focus and a 44×44 pointer target.

items.name: tag-group
items.title: Tag Group
items.description: Removable and selectable tags in a labeled group, with keyboard removal, a 24px remove button named in the user's language, intents that turn solid when selected, an empty state and an error message.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: On/off switch with its label as the click target, two sizes, and a settings-row layout with the switch at the end.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: Radio options with a group label, per-option descriptions, and a card layout where the whole option selects.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Single or range slider with a label, a locale-formatted value, a name for each thumb, and a description wired to every thumb.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Tabbed panels in a filled or line look, horizontal or vertical, with a selected tab that stays distinct in Windows High Contrast and focusable panels.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: Two-state button, pressed or not, on Button's sizes with a solid fill when on that hover can't pass for.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: A text input that filters a list of options as you type, built on React Aria Components, with a label, description and error, a clear button, sections and async loading.

items.name: native-select
items.title: Native Select
items.description: The browser's own select, styled to match the other fields, with a label, description and error from the Field parts; the system picker on phones, and it works before JavaScript loads.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Single or multiple selection from a list, built on React Aria Components, with a label, description and error; its children are the options.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: Text, icons and buttons inside an input's or textarea's border, built on React Aria's Group; clicking an addon focuses the control.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button Group
items.description: Buttons, inputs and text joined into one control, horizontal or vertical, with corners that follow the reading direction, a separator that stays visible in Windows High Contrast, and a size and variant set once for its Buttons.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: Toggles that select one, as a radio group, or many, as a toolbar, sharing a size and look, spaced or joined.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Stacked sections that expand one at a time, or several, with triggers in headings, an animated height, and find-in-page that opens a closed section.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: A trigger that shows and hides one panel, with an animated height and a trigger that takes any button look.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: A trail of links to the current page, named in the user's language, with the current page marked for screen readers and a separator that follows the reading direction.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Page links named "Page N", a current page marked by more than color and kept distinct in Windows High Contrast, Previous and Next that disable at the ends, and an announced ellipsis.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: Region that scrolls with thin native scrollbars, focusable so keyboard users can scroll it.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: Menu of actions opened from a button, built on React Aria Components, with shortcuts, descriptions, checkbox and radio groups, destructive items, links and submenus.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: Menu of actions opened at the pointer by right-click, long press or the keyboard, built on React Aria Components, sharing Dropdown Menu's items.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: Searchable list of commands, built on React Aria Components' Autocomplete and Menu, inline or in a dialog, with groups, keywords, shortcuts and descriptions.

items.name: number-field
items.title: Number Field
items.description: Number input with a label, description and error, formatted for the locale, with increment and decrement steppers either side of the value, together at one end, or none; pass children to compose the field parts.

items.name: search-field
items.title: Search Field
items.description: Search input with a leading search icon and a clear button that appears once there's text, with a label, description and error, named Search when it has no label; pass children to compose the field parts.

items.name: checkbox-group
items.title: Checkbox Group
items.description: Checkboxes with a group label, description and error above the options, vertical or horizontal, per-option descriptions, and a card layout where the whole option toggles.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: Single, multiple or range date selection in one or more months, with a today mark, unavailable dates, an error message, a loading state, and slots for the heading and a footer.

items.name: calendar-month-year-select
items.title: Calendar Month and Year Select
items.description: Month and year dropdowns for a Calendar's heading slot, rendered once however many months show, with the number of years to list.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: HTML table with optional sticky header and first column, compact and striped rows, end-aligned numbers, and a scroll area that becomes a named, focusable region only when it overflows.

items.name: date-field
items.title: Date Field
items.description: Date input made of one editable segment per unit, ordered and formatted for the locale, with a label, description and error; pass children to compose the field parts.

items.name: time-field
items.title: Time Field
items.description: Time input made of hour, minute and day-period segments that follow the locale's hour cycle, with a label, description and error; pass children to compose the field parts.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: A segmented date input with a calendar in a popover, and a time field there when the value includes a time; with a label, description and error, and slots for the calendar's heading and footer.

items.name: date-range-picker
items.title: Date Range Picker
items.description: Start and end date inputs with a range calendar in a popover, and start and end time fields there when the value includes a time; with a label, description and error, and slots for the calendar's heading and footer.
